Change c0373. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): You are my creator, but I am your master;—obey!"

1818 text: "The hour of my weakness is past, and the period of your power is arrived. Your threats cannot move me to do an act of wickedness; but they confirm me in a resolution of not creating you a companion in vice. Shall I, in cool blood, set loose upon the earth a dæmon, whose delight is in death and wretchedness.

1831 text: "The hour of my irresolution is past, and the period of your power is arrived. Your threats cannot move me to do an act of wickedness; but they confirm me in a determination of not creating you a companion in vice. Shall I, in cool blood, set loose upon the earth a dæmon, whose delight is in death and wretchedness?

Diff: " The hour of my [-weakness-] {+irresolution+} is past, and the period of your power is arrived. Your threats cannot move me to do an act of wickedness; but they confirm me in a [-resolution-] {+determination+} of not creating you a companion in vice. Shall I, in cool blood, set loose upon the earth a dæmon, whose delight is in death and wretchedness [-.-] {+?+}

Context after (unchanged): Begone!

result.rationale: Replacing 'weakness' with 'irresolution' and 'resolution' with 'determination' keeps the sense but shifts the Creature's self-presentation: he is no longer weak but undecided, and his refusal reads as a settled choice rather than a firmness of resolve. Changing the full stop to a question mark is punctuation.
